query: SELECT characters.charId AS player_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.sex, characters.online, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, clan_data.clan_name AS clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, characters.classid AS class_id, characters.LEVEL, crests.DATA AS clan_crest, (SELECT DATA FROM crests WHERE crest_id = clan_data.ally_crest_id LIMIT 1) AS alliance_crest FROM characters LEFT JOIN clan_data ON characters.clanid = clan_data.clan_id LEFT JOIN crests ON clan_data.crest_id = crests.crest_id WHERE characters.pvpkills > 0 ORDER BY pvpkills DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT characters.charId AS player_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.sex, characters.online, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, clan_data.clan_name AS clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, characters.classid AS class_id, characters.LEVEL, crests.DATA AS clan_crest, (SELECT DATA FROM crests WHERE crest_id = clan_data.ally_crest_id LIMIT 1) AS alliance_crest FROM characters LEFT JOIN clan_data ON characters.clanid = clan_data.clan_id LEFT JOIN crests ON clan_data.crest_id = crests.crest_id WHERE characters.pvpkills > 0 ORDER BY pkkills DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT characters.charId AS player_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.sex, characters.online, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, clan_data.clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, characters.base_class AS class_id, characters.level, (SELECT data FROM crests WHERE crest_id = clan_data.crest_id LIMIT 1) AS clan_crest, (SELECT data FROM crests WHERE crest_id = clan_data.ally_crest_id LIMIT 1) AS alliance_crest FROM characters LEFT JOIN clan_data ON characters.clanid = clan_data.clan_id ORDER BY characters.onlinetime DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT characters.charId AS player_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.sex, characters.online, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, clan_data.clan_name AS clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, characters.classid AS class_id, characters.level, crests.data AS clan_crest, (SELECT DATA FROM crests WHERE crest_id = clan_data.ally_crest_id LIMIT 1) AS alliance_crest FROM characters LEFT JOIN clan_data ON characters.clanid = clan_data.clan_id LEFT JOIN crests ON clan_data.crest_id = crests.crest_id ORDER BY characters.exp DESC, pvp DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT clan_data.hasCastle AS castle_id, clan_data.reputation_score, clan_data.leader_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.online, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, characters.sex, clan_data.clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, (SELECT data FROM crests WHERE crest_id = clan_data.crest_id LIMIT 1) AS clan_crest, (SELECT data FROM crests WHERE crest_id = clan_data.ally_crest_id LIMIT 1) AS alliance_crest, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM characters WHERE clanid = clan_data.clan_id) AS clan_count_members FROM clan_data LEFT JOIN characters ON clan_data.leader_id = characters.charId ORDER BY clan_data.reputation_score DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT castle.id AS castle_id, castle.treasury AS tax, castle.treasury, castle.siegeDate AS dataSiege, clan_data.clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, characters.char_name AS player_name, (SELECT DATA FROM crests WHERE crest_id = clan_data.crest_id LIMIT 1) AS clan_crest, (SELECT DATA FROM crests WHERE crest_id = clan_data.ally_crest_id LIMIT 1) AS alliance_crest FROM castle LEFT JOIN clan_data ON castle.id = clan_data.hasCastle LEFT JOIN characters ON clan_data.leader_id = characters.charId ORDER BY clan_data.reputation_score DESC;

SELECT characters.charId AS player_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.sex, characters.online, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, characters.base_class AS class_id, characters.LEVEL, clan_data.clan_name AS name, clan_data.clan_level AS clan_level, crests.data AS clan_crest, (SELECT data FROM crests WHERE crest_id = clan_data.ally_crest_id LIMIT 1) AS alliance_crest FROM characters LEFT JOIN clan_data ON characters.clanid = clan_data.clan_id LEFT JOIN crests ON clan_data.crest_id = crests.crest_id WHERE characters.account_name = ?;

INSERT INTO `character_premium_items` (`charId`, `itemNum`, `itemId`, `itemCount`, `itemSender`) SELECT ?, COALESCE(MAX(`itemNum`), 0) + 1, ?, ?, 'Bonus' FROM `character_premium_items` WHERE ? IS NOT NULL;

SELECT items.item_id AS item_id, SUM(items.count) AS total_count, (SELECT owner_id FROM items AS sub_items WHERE sub_items.item_id = items.item_id GROUP BY sub_items.owner_id ORDER BY SUM(sub_items.count) DESC LIMIT 1) AS top_owner_id, (SELECT char_name FROM characters WHERE charId = (SELECT owner_id FROM items AS sub_items WHERE sub_items.item_id = items.item_id GROUP BY sub_items.owner_id ORDER BY SUM(sub_items.count) DESC LIMIT 1)) AS top_owner_name, (SELECT SUM(count) FROM items AS owner_items WHERE owner_items.item_id = items.item_id AND owner_items.owner_id = (SELECT owner_id FROM items AS sub_items WHERE sub_items.item_id = items.item_id GROUP BY sub_items.owner_id ORDER BY SUM(sub_items.count) DESC LIMIT 1)) AS top_owner_item_count FROM items WHERE items.item_id IN (%s) GROUP BY items.item_id;
